author: Ubisoft
description:
Echoes of Central Park launches November 3. Pre-order now to receive the NY Purifier Mask at launch.

Go behind the scenes of The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park with developers from Massive Entertainment, Ubisoft Bucharest, and Ubisoft Reflections.

Discover the inspirations behind The Division 2’s darkest story yet, from the mysteries hidden within Central Park to the DLC’s haunting atmosphere, new companions, skill variants, and replayable endgame experience. Featuring the largest playable area since Warlords of New York, Echoes of Central Park takes The Division 2 into its most unsettling territory yet.

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.
